fact_english: The coconut crab, called tatus in the Philippines, is the largest arthropod that lives on land. It can climb trees, and its strong claws can break open coconuts.

lines.speaker: INDIO
lines.text: Ang tatus, ang coconut crab, ang pinakamalaking arthropod na sa lupa nakatira!

lines.speaker: USMAN
lines.text: Umaakyat pa ng puno, at kaya ng sipit niyang buksan ang niyog. Ako, de-lata nga hirap.

why_here: After 'Mali raw ang bintana ko.': a half-made reveal (which window?), answered right after the break.
